about: The Workbench icons of the Netacka drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/netacka.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: three coloured trails curving across a dark arena) is The AmiCradle Team's own, MIT like the game; art/netacka.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Netacka-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Netacka.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Netacka and COPYING.txt.
